root_idea.summary: The root centers on عرض, the dimension opposed to length: breadth, lateral presentation, or the showing of a side.
root_idea.development: From the notion of breadth or a side develop meanings of appearing, presenting or exposing something, turning aside, intervening across a path, and comparison or opposition. Many derived usages extend this lateral or oppositional orientation figuratively.

senses.definition: to display, present, or expose something to view; to offer it before someone
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for bringing a person, thing, or matter before an observer or recipient. The Quranic uses include displaying beings, presenting an offering or trust, and exposing people or things for judgment or observation; voice and tense vary by occurrence.

senses.definition: to hint at, allude to, or express something indirectly
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction refers to indirect language whose intended proposal is understood without being stated plainly, specifically an indirect marriage proposal during the waiting period.

senses.definition: to turn away from, avoid, shun, or disregard
senses.usage_conditions: Usually construed with عَنْ, but the complement may be omitted when the object of aversion is understood. The Quranic use covers physical or deliberate withdrawal from people, signs, revelation, admonition, or an affair.
The verbal noun of أَعْرَضَ; it denotes withdrawal or refusal of attention, including desertion in a personal relationship and aversion to signs or guidance.

senses.definition: a cloud bank appearing across the horizon
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the active participle is a noun for a visible mass of cloud presenting itself across the sky; the expected rain is inferred from the context, not from the word alone.

senses.definition: a worldly possession, gain, or commodity, especially a transient worldly good
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses contrast such gains with lasting spiritual or otherworldly good. In one context the word denotes booty or spoil; the common semantic feature is an attainable worldly acquisition lacking permanence.

senses.definition: broad, ample, extensive; figuratively abundant or lengthy
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression دُعَاءٌ عَرِيضٌ, the adjective describes prayer as extensive or abundant rather than specifying a physical width.

senses.definition: breadth or width, the dimension opposed to length
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use describes the immense breadth or extent of Paradise. The expression may be understood spatially or, in contextual interpretation, as indicating vastness; it is distinct from عَرَض meaning worldly goods.
In the Quranic accusative expression عَرْضًا, the noun functions as the verbal noun of presenting or exposing something, rather than as the dimension ‘width’.

senses.definition: an obstacle or butt placed in the way of something
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction جَعْلُ اللهِ عُرْضَةً لِلْأَيْمَانِ, the word can evoke either an obstacle interposed between a person and a good act or a target made the object of repeated oaths.

senses.definition: one who turns away, is averse, or refuses attention
senses.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle of أَعْرَضَ. The Quranic plural forms refer to people characterized by persistent withdrawal from signs, guidance, truth, or admonition; grammatical number and gender are inflectional only.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become broad or wide; to spread in breadth
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I usage, distinct from the transitive Quranic form عَرَضَ ‘to present’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to appear, become apparent, or present itself to someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually construed with لِ; the thing is said to show its side to the observer and thereby become visible or accessible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to happen to, befall, or occur to someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an event, disease, disturbance, doubt, or similar incident.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to intervene as an obstacle and prevent someone from reaching a goal or continuing along a way
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The obstacle may be a thing, an event, a mountain, or another intervening circumstance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to go toward, approach, or pass by someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may also mean to present oneself to or proceed toward the person addressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a horse: to run or move obliquely, inclining toward one side
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of a horse’s gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a camel: to eat from the upper parts of trees or shrubs
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of an animal: to be overtaken by disease, injury, or death
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage includes an animal dying from disease or, in another expression, dying without disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to barter or exchange a commodity for another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is equivalent to offering one commodity in exchange for another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to come to the region called al-ʿArūḍ
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic usage referring to the area around Mecca, Medina, and, in some accounts, Yemen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to revile, defame, or speak ill of someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression concerns attacking a person’s reputation or honor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to strike the side of a thing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive usage distinguished from placing something sideways.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to place or turn something breadthwise, crosswise, or sideways
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a stick, spear, bow, sword, or similar object placed across rather than lengthwise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to feed someone or offer food to him
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive form may mean that people were given food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to fill a watering-trough or waterskin
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive pastoral usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to brand a camel with the mark called عِرَاض
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The corresponding passive expression describes a camel bearing that brand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to defraud or deceive someone in a sale
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial usage concerning deceptive dealing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become mad, insane, or affected by a jinn
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or quasi-passive expression for being overtaken by madness or a supernatural affliction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to make something broad or wide
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the literal Form II widening usage, distinct from its Quranic indirect-speech construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to speak obliquely, ambiguously, or allusively
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may convey an intended meaning without stating it plainly, including an indirect marriage proposal or an equivocal phrase used to avoid a direct falsehood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to write indistinctly or with poorly formed, undifferentiated letters
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage concerning handwriting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to expose someone or something to a circumstance or danger
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is made liable or exposed to the following thing; the construction may describe causing someone to expose himself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to give one thing in exchange for, or in place of, another; to barter
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes exchanging or selling one commodity for a like commodity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to give a present or provide food, especially provisions carried on a journey
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun عُرَاضَة refers to a present or food supplied by a traveler or purveyor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to put cattle in pasturage sufficient to replace fodder
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral usage concerning the kind of grazing supplied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to acquire courage, energy, strength, and power of speech
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is associated with becoming possessed of عارضة, including eloquence or forcefulness in speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to persist in eating ʿirḍān, young goats
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical usage tied to the plural of عَرِيض.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to oppose, contend with, or be opposed by someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The relation may be opposition in disagreement or, in another construction, agreement or correspondence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to vie with, rival, imitate, or requite someone by doing likewise
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The comparison is between the breadth or character of one action and that of another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to barter or exchange commodities
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in commercial exchange and, in blood matters, for accepting compensation instead of retaliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to compete in or practice deceptive dealing in a sale
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized commercial usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to proceed opposite or alongside someone, each taking a corresponding side
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of travel, paths, and things lying over against one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to take a side route or enter a course obliquely
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes approaching a bier from an intermediate point and other lateral movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to have sexual intercourse with a woman unlawfully or without marriage
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A restricted Classical Arabic construction; it can also describe a child of unknown or illicit paternity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to compare or collate one thing, especially a book, with another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related noun may denote reading or studying together with another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a stallion: to cover a she-camel when offered to her from the side
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel may conceive by a stallion not belonging to her usual herd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to present, offer, or expose oneself or one’s side to someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V reflexive development of showing one’s side; it may also mean intruding or interfering in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to oppose, attack, or set oneself against someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, beast of prey, reptile, or other potential attacker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to address, direct, or apply oneself to an object or pursuit
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes presenting oneself to seek favor, bounty, a request, testimony, or a good action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to ask traveling companies for provisions or presents
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the travel gift or food called عُرَاضَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to expose oneself or become liable to something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction expresses voluntary or resulting exposure to an event or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to turn aside or move obliquely rather than in a straight course
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of camels, horses, and other movement that alternates toward the right and left.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become infected, corrupted, or altered so as to cease
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to love or attachment that changes or comes to an end.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to oppose, fight, compete, or imitate one another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal Form VI expresses mutual opposition or reciprocal rivalry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to lie or extend across a path and obstruct passage
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a physical object, cloud, building, mountain, or other thing that becomes an intervening obstacle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to oppose, resist, or withstand someone or something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may express refusal or resistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to interpose oneself in an affair or enter into it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes coming in upon someone or undertaking an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to interpose an objection or attribute an error to someone’s statement or action
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical argumentative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to review an army while making its members pass before the reviewer
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reviewer examines the troops to determine their condition or who is present and absent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a horse or camel: to be refractory, untoward, or difficult to manage
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage may describe an animal resisting its leader or rider.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to undertake or constrain oneself to do a difficult or troublesome thing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from taking an oblique or obstructive course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a camel or similar animal: to eat thorny plants
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral usage for feeding on thorns when ordinary herbage is unavailable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to accept an equivalent, substitute, or compensation
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of accepting a substitute for a debt or blood compensation instead of retaliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to ask someone to show or display what he has
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes asking to see a girl or commodity in a sale.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to approach someone or something from the side
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A literal sideward approach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to act at random or indiscriminately without distinguishing among those encountered
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage may describe indiscriminate killing, giving, questioning, buying, or taking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: of a she-camel: to become fat and plump
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare intransitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: breadth, width, or the mutual distance between the sides of a thing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Primarily used of corporeal things; by extension it may describe extent or vastness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: latitude in geography
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical geographic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the middle or midst of a thing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may refer to the middle of a thing, including a wall, river, property, or other expanse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a mountain, its base, side, or place of ascent
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Several closely related geographic applications are attested under this headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a collection of clouds obstructing the horizon
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cloud formation named for its breadth across the horizon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an army or great army
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation likening a large army to a mountain or horizon-filling cloud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a multitude of locusts or bees filling the horizon
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective usage based on a broad cloud-like mass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a valley
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic usage distinct from the dimension ‘width’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: something plainly before the eye or seen at a glance
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in expressions such as عَرْضَ عَيْنٍ, ‘before the eye’ or ‘at a glance’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a compensation, substitute, or thing given in place of another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial or legal interpretation of the word; it is distinct from عرض meaning ordinary goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: commodities or goods exchanged for money or other commodities
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In commercial terminology this may exclude coined silver and gold money and can denote non-cash merchandise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a side, lateral part, quarter, or outward portion
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a sword, neck, face, house, road, people, or other entity approached from a side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the middle or surrounding portion of a river, sea, story, or group of people
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as فِي عُرْضِ النَّاسِ it may mean among or in the middle portions of the people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: any part or object taken or struck indiscriminately
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions directing someone to take, strike, or eat whatever is encountered without investigating its source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the side or low region of a valley or country, and a district or province
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes named lowland districts between the Hijaz and Yemen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a valley containing towns, water, palms, or trees
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may denote the corresponding districts or lowlands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the trees called أراك, أثل, and حمض
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a person’s self, body, skin, or a bodily part
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote the person himself, the body, the skin, or a place such as the armpit or groin that sweats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the odor of the body or of another thing, whether pleasant or foul
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with adjectives meaning sweet-smelling or stinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: honor, reputation, ancestry, or grounds of social esteem
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes what a person preserves from blame and the praise or reproach attached to him, his ancestors, or those under his care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a commended natural disposition or a good action
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the person’s commendable character or standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an event, accident, misfortune, or thing that befalls someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes disease, distraction, theft, death, or another occurrence that may impede or test a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an accidental or unexpected occurrence or hit
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a random arrow or stone that strikes without being aimed at the person struck, and of something encountered unintentionally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a non-permanent property or accident inhering in a substance
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical theological and philosophical usage, including color, taste, smell, sound, motion, power, and will.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an eagerly desired object, worldly temptation, or covetous desire
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical usage related to desire for worldly goods, distinct from the Quranic noun’s direct contextual sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a gift
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general gift usage, related to but distinct from the specialized travel present عُرَاضَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a state of being liable or exposed to something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for possibility, susceptibility, or exposure to loss.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a manner of moving toward one side
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a gait approved in horses but disapproved in camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a purpose, intention, or object of desire
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is figuratively treated as a target or butt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a pretext or excuse
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical branch distinct from the Quranic obstacle or butt construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: fitness, strength, or ability sufficient for an undertaking
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or animal capable of marriage, evil, travel, or difficult terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a wrestling trick or maneuver for throwing an opponent
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized technical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a kind of cloth or garment
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical item distinct from the adjective meaning lateral.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a camel that goes obliquely, is untrained, or is difficult to manage
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form applies to a she-camel; the entry also describes an unstable rider.

other_classical_meanings.definition: sideways or heedless movement, refractoriness, roughness, or pride
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a horse, she-camel, or person according to the relevant behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: briskness, liveliness, or sprightliness
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related adjectival use describes someone or something brisk or lively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an oblique course or brisk, sidelong movement
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person’s gait or a mare or she-camel running alternately to either side; it can also describe a woman broad from plumpness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a proud, sidelong gait or looking from the outer angle of the eye
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may describe running, walking, or oblique looking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: matching or equaling another’s speech or action
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for beginning to say what another has said.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a crosswise brand or branding implement for a camel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mark may be placed on the thigh or neck and may identify footprints.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a road, especially one running through or along the side of a mountain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can also denote a way of speech by metaphorical extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an untrained or difficult she-camel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal may take an oblique course or require training.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a large quantity or multitude
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or comparative usage, as in a numerous tribe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: clouds
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic or lexical plural-like usage synonymous with cloud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: food
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the intended meaning or purport of speech
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the sense understood from a statement, as distinct from its wording.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the like or counterpart of a question or matter
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative usage meaning that one matter corresponds to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: prosody, the science of measuring Arabic verse
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term also denotes the corresponding metrical portion of a verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a transverse supporting pole or the middle structural part of a tent
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The prosodic sense is explained through this tent imagery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a geographic name for Mecca, Medina, Yemen, and surrounding regions
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the quality of being untrained in a she-camel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal describing the animal’s condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: broad or wide
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may also be extended to abundance, wealth, fatness, stupidity, or the extent of prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a young male goat, especially one approaching sexual maturity
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also denote a yearling or a goat that crops vegetation with the side of its mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a present or food brought to one’s family or offered by a traveler
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a travel gift, provisions given by a grain seller, and food requested from a water-owner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: relating to prosody; a prosodist
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical derivative of عَرُوض in the metrical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: places containing the trees called أثل, أراك, and حمض
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural geographic or botanical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an officious meddler or busybody who addresses himself to harming people
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person characterized by intrusive or harmful forwardness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: something showing its breadth, side, or face and thereby appearing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general active-participial use underlying several more specialized nominal branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an occurrence, bane, or doubt that befalls or intervenes
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an event, disease, mischief, or doubt arising in the mind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: whatever faces or comes before someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for something encountered or confronting the observer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an intervening or preventing thing; an obstacle
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A thing that prevents someone from continuing, such as a mountain or other obstruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the side of the cheek, face, mouth, beard, or neck
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical usage; the plural may refer to the two cheek-sides or related teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a side tooth or the teeth at the side of the mouth
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact dental range varies among lexical authorities; the common reference is to teeth beside the central incisors or toward the molars.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who gives a thing in exchange for another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial active-participial usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a reviewer who makes an army pass before him and examines it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional or functional designation derived from عرض الجيش.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a want or object of need that has arisen
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A need that presents itself to a person; distinct from the medical sense below.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an animal slaughtered because of disease or injury
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a camel, sheep, or goat affected by a condition, contrasted with an animal slaughtered while healthy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a camel that eats thorny trees wherever it finds them
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a transverse beam, door lintel, or roof rafter
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word denotes a structural piece laid across, including a roof beam or the upper member of a doorway.

other_classical_meanings.definition: hardiness, courage, energy, eloquence, or power of speech
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression ذُو عَارِضَة characterizes a person of resolve, courage, eloquence, or good judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the place or circumstance in which something appears, is shown, mentioned, or intended
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the setting, occasion, or manner in which a statement or action is presented.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place for displaying or selling slaves or beasts
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A market or exhibition place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: pasturage sufficient to make cattle independent of fodder
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: something showing its breadth or side and thereby appearing or becoming accessible
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The item is presented to someone’s power or view and offers no resistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who contracts debts or seeks loans indiscriminately
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression ادَّانَ مُعْرِضًا describes borrowing from whoever is available without regard to consequences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: land containing herbage that grazing animals take while traversing it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of accessible grazing land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a garment in which a girl is displayed or presented
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The garment may be used at a wedding or when presenting a girl to a purchaser.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a camel branded with the mark called عِرَاض
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle is used as a nominal for the branded animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: meat that is not thoroughly cooked
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attestation is attributed with a variant reading using ص; the عرض form is nevertheless recorded as a lexical possibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a virgin displayed to the people of a tribe before being veiled
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social usage concerning presentation for potential marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one whose exposed provisions become available to crows or other takers
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a poetic expression for a she-camel whose load is exposed to birds; it is related to offering or exposing provisions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a circumciser of a boy
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an unfeathered, headless arrow that strikes with its thick middle or side
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: If it pierces the game it may be eaten; a strike with the middle part has distinct hunting rules.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an oblique, indirect, equivocal, or allusive mode of speech
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may mean saying one thing while intending another and is used to avoid a direct lie.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a camel that does not proceed straight but takes alternately to the right and left
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an oblique or sidelong gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a person habitually cross, perverse, or displeasing in disposition
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative personal adjective derived from obstructive or oblique behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: love that befalls at first sight and captivates immediately
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative expression for sudden attachment that may depart as quickly as it came.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to subject someone or something to a force or treatment, especially the sword, whip, or fire
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as عرضهم على السيف or على السوط or على النار, the result is killing, beating, or burning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to bring someone before a judge and accuse him
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A judicial presentation and accusation construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to read or recite a written work or book
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a writing or book; the reading may be from memory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to correspond to or equal someone in grounds of honor or esteem
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative lexical interpretation of the construction concerning a person’s honor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to turn one’s side toward the wind without facing it or turning one’s back to it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of a camel positioning itself obliquely relative to the wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to look sideways or obliquely
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a sideways glance or oblique manner of looking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to extend broadly and at length
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A literal or figurative Form IV widening usage, including breadth in a thing or generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to bear children broad in build
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of a woman giving birth to broadly built children.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to state or frame a question broadly
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The question is expressed widely or at length rather than narrowly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to put young male goats up for sale
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is عِرْضَان, the plural of عَرِيض in its young-goat sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to castrate young male goats
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral usage concerning عِرْضَان.

other_classical_meanings.definition: possibly to circumcise a boy
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tentative lexical attribution in the supplied evidence, cross-referenced to the occupational noun for a circumciser.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to enter a race or course from an intermediate point
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of coming in among other horses rather than following the course from its beginning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to begin observing a month after its beginning
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The observances are commenced from an intermediate point of the month.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to engage in vain or false conduct and refuse the truth
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person who appears in what is futile and declines obedience to truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to face or advance toward someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A direct approach or advance toward the person addressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to present or address oneself to a person or an action
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes advancing, coming forward, or applying oneself to an intended action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to advance against someone with an arrow and shoot him
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction includes attacking and killing with the arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to ride while reviewing an army
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The rider makes the soldiers pass by and examines their condition or presence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to take an untrained she-camel in its untrained state
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral construction concerning an untrained camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: breadthwise, across, or crosswise
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adverbially or in expressions for crossing or placing something transversely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the Day of Judgment
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional appellation formed from the presentation or examination of people on that day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: madness, insanity, or possession by jinn
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for a state of supernatural or mental affliction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an hour or portion of the night
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for a portion of night that has passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a great cloud appearing or extending across the horizon
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cloud mass named for its appearance or lateral extension across the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an army or great army
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective designation likening an army to a horizon-filling mass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: numerous locusts
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective usage for a multitude likened to a broad mass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who falsely speaks evil of people
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal designation for a man characterized by false reviling; a feminine form is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an appurtenance or accessory
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general extension from something incidental or attached to another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: house appurtenances or chambers
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal Iraqi usage explicitly reported as unfamiliar to the Arabs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place lying opposite or across from someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a place over against another as one proceeds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a camel that eats thorny plants when ordinary herbage is unavailable
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral noun for a camel feeding on thorns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a yearling goat
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage equated with عَتُود in the supplied evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a gift appearing or presented by someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The gift is something that presents itself from a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the upper parts of trees or shrubs
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural botanical usage for the elevated or upper growth of trees.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Tentative lexical attribution preserved in usage conditions.

cautions: The same consonantal root yields several homographic nouns distinguished by vowel pattern, including عَرَض, عَرْض, عُرْض, and عِرْض; their meanings should not be conflated.
The Quranic form عَرَضَ is presented as the transitive Form I verb ‘to present or expose’; the intransitive and other specialized Form I branches remain separately recorded under Classical meanings.
The contextual English renderings are not treated as independent evidence for senses; Quranic sense assignments rely on the supplied Mufradat and Lane evidence.
